summary.intent: Complete the remaining branches of trail #201 for the caliper repo (CLI libc/loader packaging fixes and Windows verbatim path normalization) via a delegated subagent, with branches pushed and linked but no PRs opened.
summary.outcome: Two branches were pushed and linked to trail #201: fix/cli-libc-and-loader (1eb9a7f5) and fix/verbatim-windows-paths (36c0d93d). The Windows fix was never run on Windows, and 9 of 880 core Rust tests fail, attributed unverified to worktree path layout. Workers on #211 are still running.

repo: The napi loader pin in packages/napi/index.js must equal packages/napi/package.json version; it had drifted (0.6.0 vs 0.9.0) and will go stale at every Callisto version bump unless callisto.toml is changed or index.js is regenerated.

CLI linux-*-gnu npm packages (packages/cli/npm/linux-x64-gnu, linux-arm64-gnu) lacked `libc: ["glibc"]`; scripts/check-packaging.mjs now enforces this for all *-gnu packages under packages/cli/npm and packages/napi/npm, and is wired into `just lint`.

packages/cli/bin/cli.js previously could fall back to a stale target/release or target/debug binary; it now only does so when running from the repo checkout (no node_modules in path, crates/cli/Cargo.toml and packages/cli/bin/cli.js exist at repo root).

`dunce` is only a transitive dev dependency (via snapbox), so a hand-written normalizer lives in crates/core/src/canonical_path.rs. It converts `\\?\C:\...` to `C:\...` and `\\?\UNC\srv\sh` to `\\srv\sh`, and is used at canonicalize sites in pipeline/discover.rs, pipeline/watch.rs (canonicalize_best_effort) and dependency_types.rs (project_dirs).

caliper-docgen-core snapshot tests (panda, mui, radix, mantine, shadcn, rdt_compat, chakra) and two terminal_react_builtins aria tests fail in the worktree; snapshot diffs show `[ROOT]/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper/node_modules/...` instead of `[ROOT]/node_modules/...`.

code.finding: New hand-written verbatim-path normalizer with four OS-independent unit tests; written test-first against an identity stub.
New packaging lint checking loader pin version equals napi package.json version and glibc libc declarations on *-gnu packages.
Local target/release and target/debug binary fallback is now gated on running from this repo's checkout.

friction: node_modules isn't installed in the worktree, so the loader pin was edited by hand instead of regenerated via napi, and `just lint` and the TS tests couldn't run.

9 core Rust tests fail in the worktree; the cause is believed to be worktree path layout but wasn't confirmed against a clean origin/main, and one aria test's failure (`No such file or directory`) wasn't investigated.
The 'before' behavior of cli.js was inferred from reading code rather than running the old version.
open_items: Verify the 9 failing core tests against a clean origin/main to confirm they are worktree artifacts.
Run the Windows path normalization changes (discover.rs, watch.rs, dependency_types.rs) on Windows; no Windows CI job was added.
Resolve loader-pin staleness at version bumps, which requires editing callisto.toml or regenerating index.js.
Run the full `just lint` and TS tests with node_modules installed.
Investigate the second terminal_react_builtins aria test failure.
No PRs opened; `ci/linux-x64-glibc-floor` branch left untouched.
Rust and scripts workers on #211 are still running.
